name: load_csv
description: Loads a CSV file into memory as a pandas DataFrame. Call this before any other tool. Returns the dataset shape, column names, and a preview of the first five rows.

returns.description: Dataset shape, column names, and first five rows.

name: analyze_data
description: Performs exploratory data analysis on the loaded dataset. Returns descriptive statistics, missing value counts, duplicate row count, unique value counts per column, data types, and the correlation matrix for numeric columns.

returns.description: Full EDA report including stats, nulls, duplicates, and correlations.

name: run_pandas_code
description: Executes custom Python/pandas code on the loaded DataFrame. The DataFrame is available as 'df'. Use print() to return output. Use this for any custom analysis, filtering, grouping, aggregation, sorting, feature engineering, or transformation not covered by the other tools.

code.description: Python pandas code to execute. Use 'df' to access the dataset. Use print() for output.

returns.description: Printed output from the code, or an error message.

name: run_sql_query
description: Executes a SQL query on the loaded dataset using DuckDB. The dataset table name in SQL is 'df'. Use this for analytical queries, aggregations, filtering, group by, window functions, and complex joins or calculations.

query.description: SQL query to execute against the 'df' table. Example: 'SELECT column1, COUNT(*) FROM df GROUP BY column1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10'

returns.description: Tabular results of the SQL query or an error message.

name: plot_chart
description: Generates a chart from the loaded dataset and saves it as an image. Supported types: bar, line, scatter, hist, pie.

y.description: Column name for the y-axis. Not required for histograms.

returns.description: File path of the saved chart image.

name: remove_duplicates
description: Removes rows that are exact duplicates across every column, keeping the first occurrence. Does not accept any parameters - always performs full-row comparison.

returns.description: Number of duplicate rows removed and rows remaining.

name: export_csv
description: Exports the current dataset to a CSV file and returns the file path. Call this when the user wants to download or save the dataset after cleaning or analysis. The filename parameter is optional - if not specified, the file will be named 'exported_dataset.csv'.

filename.description: Optional name for the output file (without or with .csv extension). Defaults to 'exported_dataset'.

returns.description: File path of the saved CSV file.
